description: This Java class provides an implementation of the ContactAccessor interface for legacy Android API levels prior to Eclair. It includes methods to generate a contact picker intent and to load contact information (name and phone number) from the contacts stored on the device.

classes.name: ContactAccessorSdk3_4
classes.description: A subclass of ContactAccessor that implements contact retrieval using deprecated Android Contacts API for pre-Eclair versions.

methods.name: getPickContactIntent
methods.description: Creates an intent to pick a contact from the legacy contacts URI.

methods.name: loadContact
methods.description: Loads contact information (name and primary phone number) given a content resolver and contact URI.
